description: This Java class `ImmutableJsonWebKey` provides an immutable implementation of the `JsonWebKey` interface, representing a JSON Web Key (JWK). It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON strings/objects, and provides accessors for its properties including key type, algorithm, usage, ID, modulus, and exponent.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonWebKey
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the `JsonWebKey` interface, representing a JSON Web Key with properties like type, algorithm, usage, ID, modulus, and exponent.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new `JsonWebKey` instance with specified parameters after validation.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a `JsonWebKey` instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the algorithm, if present.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the key usage, if present.

methods.name: getModulus
methods.description: Returns the modulus as a BigInteger.

methods.name: getExponent
methods.description: Returns the exponent as a BigInteger.
